sections.label: THINKING
sections.content:
Hmm — the oscillation kept the bar at (44,36) (the LEFT→RIGHT pair returned it to 36), but the final LEFT moved it to (44,32), and the timer ran out there. In other words, the timer ran out at (44,32), not (44,36)! Ugh, my oscillation ended on a LEFT.
The bar was at (44,36) for most of the oscillation, but the final position when the timer hit 0 was (44,32).
So if the win condition is "the timer runs out exactly at (44,36)", then I need to make the final position (44,36). That is, the last action must leave the bar at (44,36): end the oscillation with a RIGHT (from 32 to 36), or just… hmm, the bar has to move every action. To be at (44,36) when the timer runs out: the last action must land on (44,36).
From (44,36): LEFT → (44,32), RIGHT → (44,40). To return to 36: 2 actions (LEFT+RIGHT or RIGHT+LEFT). So the oscillation count after arrival must be even!
This run: 13 actions to arrive, then 19 oscillations (odd) → ended at 32. If it had been 18 oscillations, the timer would have been 2px at (44,36)… and the 19th action would have moved it away. Hmm, the timer runs out after the 32nd action. Arrival is action 13. Actions 14–32 = 19 actions. To end at (44,36): the parity of the net column displacement over actions 14–32 must be 0. LEFT/RIGHT pairs: 19 actions = 9 pairs + 1 extra. The extra must be… any single move changes the column by ±4. So with 19 moves, you can't end at the same column!
Unless I use UP/DOWN for the extra move: e.g., 9 LEFT/RIGHT pairs + 1 UP (row 44→40), then… no, that leaves me at row 40.
Alternative: arrive at (44,36) in an even number of actions, leaving an even number of oscillations. From (16,12) to (44,36): 7 DOWN + 6 RIGHT = 13 (odd). Add 2 actions (e.g., LEFT+RIGHT or DOWN+UP… can't go below 44; LEFT+RIGHT): 15 actions, leaving 17 oscillations (odd). Hmm, still odd. 16 actions → 16 oscillations (even)! Add 3 actions: LEFT+RIGHT+? No, that's 2. Add LEFT, RIGHT, LEFT, RIGHT = 4 → 17 actions, 15 oscillations (odd).
Wait: total 32. Arrival at 13 (odd) → remaining 19 (odd). To make the remaining even, the arrival must be even: 14 actions → 18 remaining (even). Path of 14 actions to (44,36): 7 DOWN + 6 RIGHT + 1 extra? The extra move changes position. E.g., 7 DOWN + 7 RIGHT (→(44,40)) + 1 LEFT (→(44,36)) = 15. Hmm.
Or: 8 DOWN? Can't (max row 44, from 16: 7 DOWNs to reach 44; the 8th is blocked).
Path: 6 DOWN (→(40,12)), 6 RIGHT (→(40,36)), 1 DOWN (→(44,36)) = 13. Same.
Add a LEFT+RIGHT detour before the final: 7 DOWN + 5 RIGHT (→(44,32)) + RIGHT (→(44,36))… = 13. To make it 14: 7 DOWN + 4 RIGHT (→(44,28)) + LEFT (→(44,24)) + RIGHT (→(44,28)) + RIGHT (→(44,32)) + RIGHT (→(44,36)) = 7+4+1+1+1+1 = 15. Hmm.
7 DOWN + 6 RIGHT + LEFT + RIGHT = 15 (odd). 7 DOWN + 5 RIGHT + LEFT + RIGHT + RIGHT + RIGHT = 15.
To make it 14: 7 DOWN + 6 RIGHT + 1 = 14: the 14th action must leave me at (44,36): from (44,36) any move leaves (44,36). From (44,32): RIGHT → (44,36). So: 7 DOWN + 5 RIGHT (→(44,32), 12 actions) + [2 actions that net to +4 columns]: LEFT+RIGHT+RIGHT = 3 actions → 15. RIGHT+LEFT+RIGHT = 3. Hmm, 2 actions that net to +4: impossible (each move is ±4; 2 moves: net 0 or ±8).
OK: 7 DOWN + 4 RIGHT (→(44,28), 11 actions) + 3 actions that net to +8: RIGHT,RIGHT,RIGHT = 3 → 14 actions, ending at (44,36)!
Then 18 oscillations (even) → end at (44,36) when the timer runs out!
Total: 14 + 18 = 32.
But wait — is "the timer runs out at (44,36)" even the goal in the first place? I've now tested timer runout at about 8 positions, all game over. Testing (44,36) is just one more position out of 108. The probability that this is the goal is low.
Let me think more deeply.
What if the goal doesn't involve the timer at all? What if the goal is to press SPACE at the 3 special positions in a specific pattern (1–4 times each, since 5 = death)?
For example: the pin needs exactly 3, the left U needs exactly 2, the right U needs exactly 4? And the level completes when all three are satisfied?
I've never pressed SPACE at all  3 positions within a single run!
Run 5: pin only (5 times → death). Run 6: pin only. Run 8: left U only (5 times → death). Run 4: right U once.
Test: within a single run, press SPACE at the pin (1 time), the left U (1 time), and the right U (1 time). See if anything happens.
Path from (16,12): left U is column 12 (current position!): SPACE (1). Pin is column 28: 4 RIGHTs, SPACE (2). Right U is column 36: 2 RIGHTs, SPACE (3). Total: 1+4+1+2+1 = 9 actions. Then wait and see (oscillate for the remaining 23 actions).
If the level completes after the 3rd SPACE → win!
If nothing happens, I learn that a single press at each position does nothing.
Let me try it.
